note: Council of ministers record on agency budgets; nothing on local government revenue records.
Investment climate passages mention property tax only as an incentive exemption; nothing on local government revenue records.
Passages recommend property tax reform at national level; they state no local government revenue record system.
Passages name Djibouti only in regional project lists; nothing on local government revenue records.

facts.fact: The SNG-WOFI profile states local authorities are not empowered to levy taxes; in 2020 their revenue was state grants plus, for regions only, shared taxes the State transferred, so no local payer record is kept. Dated by the 2020 fiscal data; the document's own date is 2022.
None of the nine local authorities (five regions, Djibouti city and its three communes) collects its own taxes in 2020, per the profile.
